name: tune MuJoCo model XML to reduce simulation time while preserving the physics trajectory
definition: Adjust model options (e.g., integration timestep, solvers) so the same scene simulates faster over a fixed duration while reaching the same full physics state within a strict tolerance.
failure_mode: Simulation not fast enough to meet the time-percentage threshold

name: write a bash sampling loop that appends formatted CSV log lines
definition: Create a bash script that repeatedly samples the cluster state on a fixed interval, formatting each row as timestamp,total,idle,fraction and appending to a log file.
failure_mode: Wrong format, missing fields, or non-numeric values make rows fail parsing.

name: write a standalone numeric value to an output file
definition: Persist only the computed number as a parseable float in a file with nothing else.
failure_mode: extra text or non-numeric content fails float parsing

name: write a structured json results file with required keys
definition: Serialise the fitted parameters into a JSON document following an exact two-peak key layout with the naming the verifier expects.
failure_mode: Wrong keys, missing nested object, or parse failure throws the assertion.
